Class HttpMcpClient

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.continuum.mcp.HttpMcpClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
McpClient
public final class HttpMcpClient extends Object implements McpClient
HTTP-backed McpClient speaking the MCP Streamable HTTP transport (spec 2025-06-18). Lazily performs the initialize handshake before the first tools call, echoes the server-assigned Mcp-Session-Id and the MCP-Protocol-Version header, and handles both application/json and text/event-stream responses.

HTTP I/O goes through a pluggable HttpMcpClient.Transport (default: the JDK HttpClient) so the client is testable without a live server. Responses are parsed with Jackson.
